build_choice: Reduced build, converted at agent-1's request for its newer index tables (registered as exfor_x25_*). Its point tables are empty: x4pro_c5dat, x4pro_x4data, x4pro_x4cdat and x4pro_kw hold 0 rows, so the views over them return nothing. Its data points are held only as JSON text, one document per dataset, in x4pro_x5z.jx5z (2.0 GB) and per subentry in x4pro_x4z.jx4z. J4 (2026-10-28) is the current source for data points; the full build is exfor_* (lake/exfor/x4pro-2023-07-14/).

counts_check.result: differs; the build date explains it (EXFOR master as of 2025-11-05 against J4 2026-10-28)

types: DuckDB sqlite_scan with declared types, as for the 2023-07-14 build.
views: The six SQLite views are not converted; their SQL is under views_not_converted.
partitioning: none; tables over 400 MB are written as several files in source order

spend.athena: DDL is free; the row checks read Parquet footers only
